segments.description: Philippe Vergallian is a Belgian coach and performance trainer, renowned for his innovative coordination drills and athletic development strategies. His platform features over 340 video drills used by coaches worldwide. In his session Coordination Training, the key to master technical tennis skills, Philippe will demonstrate practical tools to improve movement and skill acquisition in players. Welcome Philippe. Hi coaches, my name is Philippe Vergallian, physical education teacher, performance condition trainer, youth tennis coach and I'm also the founder of Universe of Skills. I grew up and still live in Belgium and at my younger age I practiced different kinds of sports like soccer, swimming, badminton, athletics, and I played a lot on playgrounds where I developed different kinds of skills. My main sport became soccer but I also continued to practice other sports and skills. I became physical education teacher and later on I started playing tennis. I fell in love with the game and I became a condition trainer and youth tennis coach at the local club. And there I noticed very quickly that there was something wrong with most children's general skills and I decided to do something about it. Many children were unable to perform a technical movement because they were not coordinated ready for it or had not any coordinated preparation. Many times I heard a tennis trainer shout like play the ball in front of you, you're not in balance while playing, push from your legs and so on.
